item.title: CFTC submitted proposed crypto asset rules to the White House for review after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate
ECB President Lagarde blocked Binance's EU MiCA license; ESMA advised EU member states to reject the exchange's applications
Coinbase received conditional OCC approval to operate as a federal trust bank, expanding its custody and payment capabilities
Coinbase partnered with Stablecore to deliver crypto trading, custody, and stablecoins to more than 3,000 U.S. banks
SEC issued a five-year exemption allowing licensed venues to list and trade tokenized securities without exchange registration
Coinbase and Moov launched stablecoin payment infrastructure covering more than 1,000 U.S. community banks and credit unions
SEC began formal rulemaking to extend U.S. equity trading hours toward 24/7 operations, aligning with crypto market standards
JPMorgan filed to offer structured notes providing up to 1.5x leveraged exposure to BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust
The U.S. Senate voted to block the Clarity Act; the CFTC and SEC will pursue independent crypto market structure rulemaking
BlackRock, JPMorgan, and 33 other institutions launched products and services on Ethereum, advancing real-world asset tokenization
SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, creating a registration and conduct framework for digital asset investment contracts
SEC proposed rules allowing registered transfer agents to use distributed ledger technology for securities ownership recordkeeping
